# ADR trigger notes — R4.9 (2026-10-22)

Ticket 158 assigns trigger dispositions for ADR-0292, ADR-0293,
ADR-0294 and ADR-0308 (landed ADR bodies are frozen — BM-ADR-01; the
precedent is R4.7c's `2026-10-22-adr-0346-trigger.md`). The R4.9 run
ledger (`docs/build/runs/R4.9.md`) is the narrative home.

## ADR-0292 (S4.1 registry service rulings) — NOT FIRED

Trigger text: *"Revisit D3/D6 if a deployment needs a foreign system
outside the closed `ForeignSystem` sum or a non-`plugin_manifest/1`
export target…"*

R4.9 extends the **bundle** plane's foreign-*artefact* sum
(`hh_bundle::ForeignFormat` — artefact vocabularies like
`swebench_submission`/`in_toto_bundle`), not the registry plane's
`ForeignSystem` sum (foreign *registry systems* like `crates-io`).
Different closed sums, different home planes (CC10): the registry's
`ForeignSystem`/`plugin_manifest/1` rulings are untouched. The pattern
itself was reused deliberately — closed enum + typed arms, additive
extension (D3's own "new enum arm + lift/export arm" shape).

## ADR-0293 (S4.2 experiment & bundle rulings) — FIRED-ANSWERED
(ruling 7's DF-S4.2-2 discharged; ruling 4's DF-S4.2-1 stays OPEN)

Trigger text: *"DF-S4.2-1/2 landing (remote fetch transports or the
remaining foreign vocabularies) reopens ruling 4/7's deferral rows…"*

DF-S4.2-2 lands here: ruling 7's parked set — `swebench_submission`,
`inspect_eval_log`, `in_toto_bundle`, `telemetry_trace` — now lifts
through the same `kernel.import` head the ruling made general
(`format ∈ ForeignFormat::lifts()`, hosted `unverified` bundles,
`origin = import(...)`, `ImportRecord` + `MappingReport` with typed
claim/loss records). Ruling 7 stands unchanged — its *deferral row* is
discharged, which is what the trigger asked. The four lifts go beyond
the spec's printed import set — declared-but-unlifted is now lifted;
ADR-0370 records that as the additive admission it is (CC8).

Ruling 4's DF-S4.2-1 (remote fetch transports + trust fields) is
explicitly **not** this ticket's scope — it stays OPEN, owned by R4.15d
post-GATE-G7. No transport or trust-field code landed.

## ADR-0294 (S4.3 analysis & results C1 rulings) — NOT FIRED

Trigger text: *"When a ticket lands a foreign leaderboard target whose
slots are a superset of `LoweringLossReport`'s named losses, the report
vocabulary should be re-ratified."*

R4.9 lands foreign **bundle** export targets, not leaderboard targets —
no leaderboard slot set changed, and every new loss row rides the
landed `{member, address, class, detail}` shape. The one additive class
value (`unparseable`) is a value in the open string field, not a shape
or vocabulary-semantics change; the report vocabulary did not need
re-ratification.

## ADR-0308 (S4.15 C1 measurement-depth rulings) — NOT FIRED

Trigger text: *"Reopen if (a) a foreign format needs partial-fidelity
slots that `LossEntry` cannot name …"*

All four formats' lowering losses fit `LossEntry`'s shape — classes
used: `no_slot`, `narrowed`, `untyped_slot`, plus the additive
`unparseable` value (a foreign line that is not the format's grammar —
a fidelity *statement*, not a slot the shape cannot name). Nothing was
dropped for want of a slot. Prongs (b) (parity-bearing stratum-G
adapter) and (c) (richer `CalibrationStatus`) are unrelated to this
ticket's scope and stand.
